correct_elements: Your draft already gets the main mathematical content right: it asks for the nonvanishing of χ_Q^k in H^{2k}(BDiff_+^ω(S^1)_δ; ℚ), uses the correct coefficient field ℚ, the correct cohomological degree 2k, and the correct range k ≥ 2. This matches Question 8.4 essentially verbatim. ([conferences.cirm-math.fr](https://conferences.cirm-math.fr/wp-content/uploads/2025/03/Problem_list_3082.pdf))
missing_details: χ_Q should be named explicitly as the universal Euler class of flat S^1-bundles with rational coefficients; that definition is supplied in the paragraph immediately preceding Questions 8.3–8.4. ([conferences.cirm-math.fr](https://conferences.cirm-math.fr/wp-content/uploads/2025/03/Problem_list_3082.pdf))

The notation Diff_+^ω(S^1)_δ should be unpacked for stand-alone readability as the group of orientation-preserving real-analytic diffeomorphisms of S^1, regarded with the discrete topology; BDiff_+^ω(S^1)_δ is its classifying space. The paper leaves this implicit in notation. ([conferences.cirm-math.fr](https://conferences.cirm-math.fr/wp-content/uploads/2025/03/Problem_list_3082.pdf))
χ_Q^k should be described as the k-fold cup power of χ_Q in cohomology. ([conferences.cirm-math.fr](https://conferences.cirm-math.fr/wp-content/uploads/2025/03/Problem_list_3082.pdf))

The quantifier should be explicit: the question asks whether the nonvanishing holds for every integer k ≥ 2, not just for a single unspecified k. ([conferences.cirm-math.fr](https://conferences.cirm-math.fr/wp-content/uploads/2025/03/Problem_list_3082.pdf))

To stay fully faithful to the paper’s intent, the real-analytic flat S^1-bundle setting should be stated explicitly, since the surrounding paragraph contrasts this unknown analytic case with the already-known C^∞ case. ([conferences.cirm-math.fr](https://conferences.cirm-math.fr/wp-content/uploads/2025/03/Problem_list_3082.pdf))
refined_question: Let χ_Q ∈ H^2(BDiff_+^ω(S^1)_δ; ℚ) denote the universal Euler class of flat real-analytic S^1-bundles with rational coefficients, where Diff_+^ω(S^1)_δ is the orientation-preserving real-analytic diffeomorphism group of S^1 endowed with the discrete topology. Is the k-fold cup power χ_Q^k nonzero in H^{2k}(BDiff_+^ω(S^1)_δ; ℚ) for every integer k ≥ 2?
justification: The exact target is Question 8.4 in Section 8.3, not the neighboring Question 8.3. The identifying match is exact: same group BDiff_+^ω(S^1)_δ, same rational cohomology, same class χ_Q, same degree 2k, and same range k ≥ 2. The preceding paragraph provides the hidden notation by defining χ_Q as the universal Euler class of flat S^1-bundles with rational coefficients, and it explains the intended scope by recalling that the smooth analogue χ_Q^k ≠ 0 in H^{2k}(BDiff_+^∞(S^1)_δ; ℚ) is known for all k ∈ ℕ, whereas “nothing is known” in the real-analytic case. That is why the refined question should explicitly name the universal Euler class and the discrete real-analytic diffeomorphism group, but should not be broadened beyond Question 8.4. ([conferences.cirm-math.fr](https://conferences.cirm-math.fr/wp-content/uploads/2025/03/Problem_list_3082.pdf))
